summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana instruct the grieving Vanaras to perform Bali’s funeral rites, and his body is ceremonially carried and mourned before cremation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Tara sits beside Bali’s body on the funeral bed, lifting his head onto her lap while the widowed queens wail around them in the forest clearing.
Monkeys carry Bali’s ornamented body on a richly decorated palanquin covered with flowers, pearls, and red sandal paste.
On a lonely sandbank by a mountain torrent, countless monkeys build a great funeral pyre while the forest echoes with mourning cries.
